notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast.
When Bloodghast dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
